live-2026-10-11.notes: Captured for #531 with only the four corpus-lifecycle generations (HISTORY_CORPUS_GENERATIONS). The worker and client ran natively on macOS arm64 against a Compose Temporal stack under its own project name and frontend port. The working tree was clean at sdk_commit, which contains the frozen lifecycle definitions. The capture script ran with capture ID live-2026-10-11-lifecycle; the same recorded runs were then re-exported unchanged by export-history-corpus.py with capture ID live-2026-10-11 so entry IDs do not repeat the word lifecycle. The handover run was started by the corpus-lifecycle-legacy process, parked, and finished by a fresh corpus-lifecycle-patched process.

Two signals recorded before the first workflow task are delivered with initialization, before the root runs.
